title: Space, person, product and listing structured data publish a kit logo as a relative address

source.ref: Mega pass 2026-11-19 (backwards test from the production crawl: JSON-LD URL check)

detail: Backwards test 2026-11-19: crawling production and reading every JSON-LD node found 20 Space pages (The Group chapters, Alli Rae, Free Human, Mindless and their tabs) whose LocalBusiness image was a root-relative path such as /brand/the-group/the-group-sd-logo.png. A structured-data URL must be absolute: the Rich Results test and answer engines drop or misread a relative one, so these Spaces published no logo of their own. Fix: absUrl() in lib/jsonld.ts makes any row-supplied image absolute on the site origin (or the Space website's own origin in siteEntitySchema) and leaves absolute URLs alone; spaceSchema, personSchema, siteEntitySchema, productSchema and housingListingSchema use it.

verify.note: Fails on main: the five builders pass a row's image through raw. Passes when each goes through absUrl.
